author: Mencius Moldbug
binding_conditions: GI1 — N1 absolute: nothing dissolves, sheds, cracks, or comes apart in any plate. p1c7 twin chapels separate; they do not ruin.
GI2 — Dose arc felt side-by-side: p1c1 narthex dark → p1c4–p1c8 nave candlelight → p1c9 crossing lamp → p1c10 rose light → p1c11 full sanctuary.
GI3 — Piranesi second-state rule: bitten line + tonal mass, no mid-tone murk; plates hold as authored image at ~200px on phones.
GI4 — Marcellus display (large-only) + quiet Source Serif 4 body; voice from plates + dose numerals.
GI5 — One flame grammar (Candle #DFA050) across all 11 plates; Sanctuary Red #A83A2C for ember accents + p1c10 rose only; light drawn as flat stepped mass, never blurred halos.
GI6 — Prototype: cover + p1c1 + p1c5 westwork flagship + p1c6 + p1c11 at 1440×1000 / 820×1180 / 390×844.
GI7 — Benchmark: judged beside the homepage through this book's stone-still identity; quiet doses earn beauty via composition, numerals, rules, controls.

A.arc: Narthex — outer arches, near-black fields, ember accents
A.fields: darkest plates; Sanctuary Red ember dominates; candle small and distant

B.arc: Nave — receding arcades, candlelight spreading; p1c5 westwork flagship is the most ambitious interior plate
B.fields: mid-arc light; Candle spreads bay by bay

C.arc: Crossing → Sanctuary — Candle-dominant; p1c10 rose (Sanctuary Red + Candle); p1c11 full-light climax
C.fields: most luminous plates; p1c11 may carry Vellum fields

cover.composition: Full-bleed plate, architecture right-of-center; inscriptional title block overlays the calm left-third night field; eleven dose-notches ember→gold along the base (may light with real read[] progress). Minimum one third of viewport; never cropped below the portal + notches on phones.

body.role: Reading prose, TOC titles, captions. Quiet by GI4; carries no display duty.
body.verification: HTTP 200 @font-face (Crimson batch request 2026-10-15 returned Source Serif 4 400/600 + italic); computed-style check owed by engineer at prototype review

chrome.role: Buttons, settings, header meta. Shared UI voice, retained.

display.role: Cover title, chapter titles, dose numerals, TOC numerals, section labels. Large-only (≥1.5rem); never body, never forced all-caps.
display.verification: HTTP 200 @font-face (Marcellus request 2026-10-15, gstatic TTF); computed-style check owed by engineer at prototype review

fonts.registry_note: Fraunces / Newsreader / Plex Mono / Cinzel deliberately avoided (closed or crowded per ART-DIRECTION.md §4). Marcellus unheld — GI4 grants it to this book. Source Serif 4 is a permitted quiet text face; voice comes from plates + numerals.

hooks.chapter_art_slot: #chapter-art (figure above #chapter-meta; manifest src inlined; class per entry; hidden when no entry)
hooks.css_scope: body[data-book="gentle-introduction"] + body[data-chapter] / body[data-art]; unlayered book CSS wins over @layer shared; tokens scoped per contract §8
hooks.end_seal: body[data-chapter]-qualified .chapter-text > p:last-child::after with url() art ≤32px (contract A.0); eleven authored seal tints, never modulo
forbidden: No modulo/hash/paragraph-count styling presented as art
No blur-filter halos (GI5); no ambient animation loops (P9)

surfaces: cover (west front + ajar portal + eleven dose-notches)
prototype.themes: Dark-first; light + sepia verified with FIXED dark plates (O2 precedent)

tokens.flame: Single flame path grammar shared across all plates (see cover.svg candle); Candle gradient ember→gold #A83A2C → #DFA050 → #F4D9A0 for the flame body only.
tokens.notes: Six named hues. Derived tones via opacity steps of these six only — no new hues. Sanctuary Red is graphics-only (fails text contrast on dark); Candle + Vellum + Ashen carry text duty.

roles.Ashen: Muted meta, secondary rules, stone highlights
roles.Candle: The light: flame, spilling wedges, dose-numeral gold end, active states, drop caps
roles.SanctuaryRed: Ember accents, dose-notch red end, p1c10 rose. Never body text.
roles.Vellum: Primary text, candle wax, star points
